Publish a component to the Market.

What it does:
  1. Checks the login state (credentials or sources.authToken); errors when not logged in
  2. Reads component.yaml in the component directory and validates the Manifest format
  3. Checks that the image reference is valid and that every file declared under artifacts exists
  4. Creates a draft version → uploads the artifacts → turns it stable
  5. Sets the visibility (--visibility)

Publishing in three steps is deliberate: when a version turns stable the Market checks that "the files match the artifacts declaration",
and creating a draft first guarantees there is never a half-finished "already stable but files not all uploaded" version.

--path also accepts the archive directory, for example ./components/.archived/erp/backend.

Usage:
  brickkit publish [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit publish --path ./components/people/basic
  brickkit publish --path ./components/people/basic --visibility private
  brickkit publish --path ./components/people/basic --changelog "added a person status field"

Flags:
      --changelog string        Release notes for this version
      --git-url string          Git repository address of an open-source component (defaults to the origin of the component directory)
  -h, --help                    help for publish
      --key string              Path of the cosign private key (default cosign.key)
      --market string           Market address (defaults to the market install source in brickkit.yaml)
      --no-pin-digest           Don't pin the image tag to a digest (pinned by default; when skipped, the signature stays valid if the same tag is replaced on the registry)
      --path string             Component source directory (containing component.yaml) (default ".")
      --public-key-ref string   Public key ref written into the signature (derived from --key by default, .key → .pub)
      --sign                    Sign the component with cosign before publishing
      --signed-by string        Signer identifier, for example release-bot@example.com
      --source-type string      Source type: git (open source) | registry (closed source). Inferred from the component directory's git remote by default
      --visibility string       Visibility: public | private (defaults to the Market-side setting)

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
